title: Evolutionary selection vs random search at equal evaluations
purpose: Primary test: does EVO return higher held-out fitness than RS at E=2000 (NOSEL as no-selection control)
primary_outcome: F_test of returned policy (food items per episode, higher is better)
planned_analysis: paired bootstrap 95% CI of mean EVO-RS difference over 30 run seeds; d_z; secondary EVO-NOSEL

title: Ablations of mutation and selection
purpose: Estimate the contribution of mutation (sigma=0) and selection (NOSEL) and the effect of sigma in {0.02,0.5}
planned_analysis: paired bootstrap CIs for EVO minus each ablation, descriptive

title: Robustness to budget and training-set size
purpose: Sensitivity analysis that can invalidate EXP-001: E in {500,8000} and K=1 fixed training environment
primary_outcome: F_test of returned policy; generalisation gap
planned_analysis: paired bootstrap CI per condition; sign consistency; K1 overfit_drop = F_train_fixed - F_test per arm and EVO-RS
